summary: Recovered the actual Calendar/Habits surface without rebuilding it. catalog/pages.json registers calendar as live at ../pages/calendar/index.html, but the serving gh-pages entry now immediately redirects ordinary visits to pages/calendar/previews/habits-traces-v1/. That target is a unified Calendar / Habits / Money shell. Habits has a 14-day history UI, fixed tracker groups, streak/graph behavior, and a v31 persistence bridge that migrates legacy localStorage into PrometeoDB/IndexedDB, keeps a local mirror/outbox fallback, and loads the current traces-v24 + habits-v26 behavior. Therefore calendar/habits is EXISTING, not merely planned. Durable project metadata is behind the implementation: PROJECT_INDEX does not bind a calendar-habits project, and Catalog still describes the older calendar surface. The clearest evidence-backed user-visible frontier is that the Habits roster is source-hardcoded in traces-v24.js. A deduplicated LAB successor was created to make trackers user-configurable while preserving existing event history and persistence semantics.
tests: Resolved Catalog calendar entry to its exact href and historical source marker.

Checked the live derived portfolio root before spawning; no calendar-habits successor directory existed, then created a unique dedupe_key calendar-habits:custom-trackers:v1.

Making that roster user-configurable is a bounded user-visible improvement grounded in the recovered bytes and can be done preserve-first without rebuilding Calendar/Habits/Money.
